name: Qingdao Yunlu Advanced Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Yunlu Advanced Materials Technology Co., Ltd. researches, designs, develops, produces, and sells advanced magnetic metal materials in China and internationally. The company offers amorphous alloy ribbon and core; nanocrystalline alloy material, and magnetic powder. Its products are used 5G infrastructure, power distribution, photovoltaic, rail transit, data center, home appliances, new energy vehicles, heavy ion scientific research and other fields. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
